hypotheses: AR-A014418 at 3 uM for 24 h in A375 produces a reproducible histone-mark perturbation, with the strongest measured anchor feature being H3K9me2K14ac1 (standardized 2.9647) and additional changes in H3K27 methylation/acetylation states.

Donors with high anchor similarity to the AR-A014418 A375 histone response are more likely to transfer a target-minus-A375 response that preserves the H3K9me2K14ac1 increase and H3K27me2K36me1 decrease.

The fixed external decoder will select one target cell/feature/sign; donor pharmacology should be retrieved for the highest-anchor-similarity candidates to assess whether their known mechanisms plausibly overlap with AR-A014418-associated chromatin states without claiming causality.
object.evidence_gap: No donor response values are provided in the candidate list, and the query source only states that AR-A014418 is an organic molecular entity. The pharmacology descriptions for the selected donors are needed to judge whether their mechanisms are relevant to the observed histone-mark changes; measured donor responses must be used rather than fabricated.
